name: Prompt Cleaner MCP Server
description: Enables cleaning and sanitizing prompts through an LLM-powered tool that removes sensitive information, provides structured feedback with notes and risks, and normalizes prompt formatting. Supports configurable local or remote OpenAI-compatible APIs with automatic secret redaction.
